basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old hobbyist from Manchester, UK, with a passion for music and crafting. I play the guitar, mostly Schecters, and enjoy making small figurines and art pieces with polymer clay in my free time. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me a flexible schedule, usually online during late evenings. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my downtime exploring new hobbies or diving into the latest tech gadgets.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a self-taught background in music, particularly with guitars, and have been playing for over a decade. My interest in crafting with polymer clay started as a creative outlet and has become a significant hobby. I have a moderate understanding of technology, often learning through online resources and trial and error.
